subject: Founder perk addendum request: accelerator cohort sweetener
messages:
From: Sam Kline <sam@orbitaccelerator.org>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Rios <emily@orbitaccelerator.org>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Quick question: possible founder "sweetener" on next cohort?

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the demo last month — Orbit's founders loved the latency numbers and the pricing flexibility you showed. We're finalizing the sponsorship package for our Dec cohort and have a last-minute ask from our partners: can Redwood layer a small "founder perk" on top of the existing free credits we negotiated?

Ask in plain terms: add an extra $2,000 in free credits per accepted founder (in addition to the promos already in the contract) for this single six-week cohort. The perk would be conditioned on a usage milestone (50k tokens within 60 days) and we only need the addendum to cover this specific cohort — not a permanent program change.

Why Orbit is asking: it materially increases acceptance and helps us market Redwood as the preferred runtime in our sponsor messaging. It would be part of the founder welcome docs and not an ongoing contractual discount beyond the cohort.

Attached is our cohort MAP (pilot-MAP-v2.pdf) so you can see the cohort size and timelines. Can you let us know whether this is something you can do, and if so what the billing/amendment path looks like?

Appreciate a quick green/amber/red so we can finalize sponsor comms by next Thursday.

Best,
Sam Kline
Program Director, Orbit Accelerator
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Sam Kline <sam@orbitaccelerator.org>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick question: possible founder "sweetener" on next cohort?

Hi Sam — thanks for the note and the MAP.

Short answer: probably yes, but I need to align on commercial guardrails and the approver path. A few clarifying Qs so we can move fast:

- How many accepted founders are expected on this cohort (estimate)?
- Do you expect the $2k to be redeemable per founder immediately, or only if the milestone is hit? (you mentioned a 50k-token within 60 days — confirm if it's per founder)
- Do you want the credits to be issued as upfront promo credits or as a post-usage rebate/credit on the invoice?

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Ben, can you sketch the commercial path (what we can approve without finance/legal sign-off, and what needs escalation)?
2) Marissa, if we sign off commercially, we'll need a one-page addendum + invoice schedule — can your ops team stand this up within a week?
3) Sam — if you can send an estimated founder list (names + emails) we can scope identity checks for compliance.

I'll loop in Ben and Marissa so we don't lose time.

On Tue, Nov 10, 2026 at 09:18 Sam Kline <sam@orbitaccelerator.org> wrote:
> Hi Avery,
> 
> Thanks again for the demo...
>
Best,
Avery Johnson
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Sam Kline <sam@orbitaccelerator.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick question: possible founder "sweetener" on next cohort?

Thanks for pulling this together, Avery. Sam — this is doable; below is the commercial approach I recommend to keep approvals light and ops simple.

Commercial proposal (draft, for discussion):
- Base: existing promo credits remain unchanged.
- Sweetener: additional $1,500 in upfront promo credits per founder (we can do $2k but need elevated approval).
- Condition: credits vest as upfront balance, but are subject to clawback if cohort-level milestone is not reached (we'll define a 60-day usage window and a 50k-token cohort aggregate).
- Billing treatment: issue promo credits on the onboarding invoice (zero-dollar line item) and reconcile post-cohort; if clawback applies we'll issue an invoice for the reclaimed amount or apply to future invoices.

Approval levels:
- Sales can approve up to $1,500 per founder without finance sign-off.
- >$1,500 per founder requires Marissa (program ops) and finance verbal sign-off.

If Orbit needs the full $2,000, we can fast-track a one-off exception — Ben Carter to confirm with finance — but that will add one business day. I've attached a quick redline (founder-perk-term-redline.docx) that shows the one-pager amendment language I would use.

If that direction is acceptable, I'll draft the addendum and CC finance for a brief sign-off.

Ben
Director, Strategic Accounts
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Sam Kline <sam@orbitaccelerator.org>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick question: possible founder "sweetener" on next cohort?

Thanks team — Ben's approach looks good and operationally feasible. I'm comfortable approving a one-off exception up to $2,000 per founder for this specific cohort provided we capture the following in the addendum:

- Limited scope: list the cohort dates and call out that the perk applies only to the Dec 2026 cohort.
- Performance guardrail: cohort-level milestone (50k aggregate) with explicit clawback mechanics.
- Founder identity capture: we need the names/emails at signing to prevent duplicate redemption and for KYC checks.
- Invoice path: credits shown on onboarding invoice; final reconciliation within 30 days after cohort close.

Ops note: Sam, please send the expected founder count and the founder list by EOD Monday so my team can reserve the promo allocations in our billing system.

Marissa Cole
Program Ops, Redwood Inference

On Thu, Nov 12, 2026 at 14:30 Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com> wrote:

Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick question: possible founder "sweetener" on next cohort? — next steps

Sam — good news: Marissa has approved a one-off exception up to $2,000 per founder for the Dec cohort with the guardrails Ben outlined. Outline of next steps (agreed):

1) Orbit: send estimated founder count and the list (names + emails) by EOD Monday, 16 Nov.
2) Redwood: Ben will prepare the one-page addendum and route to finance for a quick OK (Ben to send draft by Monday morning).
3) Orbit & Redwood: sign addendum via DocuSign; credits issued on onboarding invoice and reconciled post-cohort.
4) Ops: Marissa will reserve the promo allocations in billing once founder list received.

Links: HubSpot deal and DocuSign envelope linked below — I'll add Ben/Marissa as approvers on the envelope.

- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/48291/deal/48291
- DocuSign envelope (draft addendum): https://docusign.com/envelope/0a7f9b2c

If you want the full $2k and can confirm cohort size is <40 founders, we can push the full amount; otherwise we will default to $1.5k per founder to keep approvals light.

Thanks — we should be able to finalize before your sponsor comms deadline.

Best,
Avery
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
